## Checklist

- [ ] If frontend was touched: `cd frontend-react && npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `[Unreleased]` (skip for tiny doc fixes)
- [ ] No new external dependencies added (or there's an issue discussing them)
